agent_notes: Both supplied NIRF 2025 Management and Overall listings contain the exact institution name with Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh.
The MBA-specific official site bitmmba.ac.in was used; the broader bitm.ac.in engineering site and its programmes were excluded as a separate campus/institution context.
